title: A \ B, B \ A and A Δ B
caption: With A = {1, 2, 3, 4} and B = {3, 4, 5}: A \ B = {1, 2} is the part of A outside B, B \ A = {5} the part of B outside A, and the symmetric difference A Δ B = {1, 2, 5} joins the two, leaving out the shared 3 and 4.
alt: A two-circle Venn diagram: 1 and 2 only in A, 3 and 4 in both, 5 only in B.
description: Place each element: 1 and 2 are only in A; 3 and 4 are in both; 5 is only in B.
A \ B is what is left of A once the overlap is removed: {1, 2}.
A Δ B takes both outer parts: {1, 2, 5}.
